description:
Hi, I'm Ishant Arora from India. I came up with the idea for EarthAudia, researched it, and built it. I love learning how technology works and turning complex ideas into simple, meaningful experiences. Our team built a tool that lets everyone experience Earth science through sound. Aryan Nandan researched my idea and helped shape it into a project. The Earth is speaking. Are you listening? Visit my website to hear it for yourself. This is original work. 

https://earthaudia.earth
